subject: Operational access snapshot & DPIA addendum request — Eucalypt Labs
messages:
From: Samir Patel <security@eucalyptlabs.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@eucalyptlabs.com
Date: 2027-08-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request — operational access snapshot + Art.30 extract for onboarding

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's deployment options yesterday. As part of our internal DPIA addendum and procurement checklist we need a small package of operational evidence before legal signs the final DPA addendum. Can you provide the following by EOD Tuesday (2027-08-10)?

- A 90-day access snapshot showing agents/users who accessed processing systems that handle our data (UTC timestamps, role, action). We do not need full payloads but need identifiers and actions.
- An excerpt of your Article 30 register (processing activities scoped to Eucalypt Labs).
- Current subprocessor inventory with locations and any cross-border transfers called out.
- KMS key attestation (who can unwrap customer keys; high-level HSM/KMS provider).
- Confirmation of audit rights / on-site or remote logistics and any 3rd-party SOC/ISO reports you can share.

If you need to redact IP addresses or user IDs, that is fine — we just need traceability for our auditors. If there are any scope issues (retention windows, masking), please highlight them.

Appreciate a quick note on plan & ETA.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Senior InfoSec Manager | Eucalypt Labs
attachments: none

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai <priyom_das@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request — operational access snapshot + Art.30 extract for onboarding

Samir — thanks for the clear list. We can provide a curated package by Monday morning (2027-08-09) with preliminary artifacts and a secure link, and then deliver a more detailed extract on Tuesday if you still need it.

Quick clarifying Qs so we scope correctly:
- Do you need the full 90-day window ending today (2027-08-07) or aligned to calendar (e.g., 2027-05-09 to 2027-08-07)?
- For the Art.30 extract: do you want CSV with column headers we can provide, or a redacted PDF narrative?
- Are you OK with redaction of IP addresses and internal usernames (we will preserve hashed/opaque IDs for traceability)?

Plan: I will pull the Art.30 excerpt and subprocessor inventory and ask Ops to produce an "access-snapshot-90d.csv" with actions. Marissa, Karthik — can you confirm availability to pull KMS attestation and scoped ledger?

Regards,
Priyom

Marissa / Karthik — forwarding Samir's ask from Eucalypt. Please see bullets below — we need a curated packet (no raw logs in the thread) and a secure share link. Priorities: Art.30 scoped to this account, 90-day access snapshot with opaque IDs, subprocessor list with transfer notes, and KMS attestation.

Specific requests:
- Access snapshot: 90-day window ending 2027-08-07. Include: UTC timestamp, actor (role + hashed id), action (read/write/cache-evict), resource scope (model/service name). Redact IPs.
- Art.30: CSV with columns: processing_activity, purpose, categories_of_data, recipients, retention. Highlight any cross-border transfers.
- Subprocessor inventory: include vendor name, country, purpose of processing, and contract start date.
- KMS attestation: one-pager on key control model + provider + who has unwrap rights inside Redwood.

Timeline: Samir asked for EOD Tue (2027-08-10), but I proposed Mon morning (2027-08-09). If we can get a first-pass bundle by end of day tomorrow I will send to them.

Notes: Follow our standard redaction pattern — hash internal usernames, remove IPs, and mark any field that is sampled. If legal needs to review the KMS attestation wording, loop in laura_bennett.

Thanks,
Priyom

Ready / attached to secure share (stubs listed below):

- art30-extract-20270807.csv (processing_activity, purpose, categories_of_data, recipients, retention)
- kms-attestation-2027-07.txt (provider: CloudHSM Inc; HSM-backed keys; internal unwrap limited to key-ops role — see one-pager)

Notes / redaction guidance:

- Usernames hashed with sha256(prefix + id). Keep mapping file internal only.
- The access snapshot includes actions from infra automation — I flagged these rows with "system" role so you can drop them if Eucalypt doesn't need them.

I will upload to internal secure-share and provide the external link after you confirm redaction threshold. If legal needs to tweak the KMS language, we can move that offline to Laura.

ETA: Files uploaded to internal staging at 2027-08-08T10:40. Ready for your final review.

—Marissa
